subject: Business Models
title: Autonomous Vehicle Fleets
description: A fast breakdown of Autonomous Vehicle Fleets for builders.

hook.text: Waymo operates robotaxis in San Francisco and Phoenix. No driver, no tip, no awkward conversation.

buildup.text: Autonomous vehicle fleets eliminate the driver—the largest cost in ride-hailing at 60-70% of the fare.

discovery.text: Without driver costs, robotaxis could charge $0.50/mile versus $2-3/mile for Uber. Cheaper than car ownership.

twist.text: Liability is unresolved. When a robotaxi crashes, who pays—the software maker, the car maker, or the fleet operator?

climax.text: Autonomous fleets could eliminate car ownership for urban residents. The car becomes a service, not a possession.

punchline.text: No driver, $0.50/mile. The autonomous fleet makes car ownership optional.

quiz.question: How much could autonomous fleets reduce ride costs?
